name: NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection
old_description: With more than 20 years in the industry, President Karen L. Williams founded NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC in 2014.
about:
NOLA Steele Fabrication and Erection LLC was founded in 2014 by Karen L. Williams in Harvey, Louisiana. Williams brought more than 20 years of industry experience to the venture, establishing the company as a woman-owned and service-disabled veteran-owned small business with additional certifications as a minority-owned, economically disadvantaged women-owned, and 8(a) firm.

The company provides structural steel erection, custom steel fabrication (including design, stairs, additions, alterations, maintenance, and repairs), skilled labor supply (welders, fitters, riggers, tackers, ironworkers, painters, and sandblasters), miscellaneous steel work such as handrails, guardrails, and balconies, stair stringer fabrication and installation, repair welding, steel supply, and limited steel demolition. It operates with a team of 35 trained professionals and has completed over 500 projects since inception.

NOLA Steele serves the construction sector, supporting new commercial and industrial construction, renovation, and repair projects. Its certifications position it for government and public-sector work, and its client base includes general contractors, developers, and agencies requiring certified small-business participation.

The firm emphasizes a thorough quality-control program and adherence to high safety standards, aiming to exceed project criteria for excellence and customer satisfaction. Its track record of 20-plus years of experience, 500-plus completed projects, and a certified workforce are cited as key differentiators.
